scope: One finite metadata retirement and module-documentation migration. This attestation does not certify a theorem, source equivalence, compiler run, complete current-tree privacy, Git-history anonymization, or release readiness.
hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 file bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization only; do not strip whitespace or erase strings.

source_migrations.change: Delete one planned task record; preserve all other code.
Delete one planned literature record; preserve all other code.
Replace only two module-documentation lines; preserve all mathematical code.

gate_review.accepted: Exact path and exact old/new LF digest pair; complete declaration/inventory syntax scan precedes target exclusion. Additional source edits restore the ordinary conservative gate.
gate_review.preserved: Existing publication bindings, full-module context freshness, private-provider owner checks, whole-project validation and ordinary mathematical publication rules.
gate_review.not_run: No compiler, repository-wide publication check, generated-site build or release gate was independently run for this attestation.
gate_review.policy: Document this finite exception explicitly. It is not a generic comment, string, metadata, import or whole-file bypass.

remaining_boundary: Regenerate and check active public views separately. Preserve sealed historical originals and their binding integrity; any portable successor needs its own lineage and fresh review. Historical privacy remains outside this attestation.
